summary: Lipocine filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce the initiation of BLOOM, a Phase 3 study of LPCN 1154 (oral brexanolone) for postpartum depression, with first participant dosing expected in early Q4 2026 and roughly 120 severe PPD participants planned. The design follows recent FDA feedback and prior Phase 3 learnings, where post hoc analyses excluding one high-enrolling site suggested benefit. Existing resources are expected to fund the study. This is a clinical-development update, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation apply.
